render_transparency: render RGB image patches with transparency using black as the transparent colour
render_masked_transparency: render RGB image patches using alpha channel for patch transparency with clipped or normed mode
render_overlap: render RGB image patches by overlaying them on top of one another using softmax-weighted order
render_with_background: render RGB image patches with an optional background image tensor added to the output
render_invert_colours: render RGB image patches with inverted colours by passing the invert_colours flag
